failure.summary: An uninjected node-1 manager attempted a contribution after generation 3 had closed, received RuntimeError: generation is not open, and consumed an atomic-cohort restart. The planned node-1 manager-loss injection later fired after generation-4 node apply, but the supervisor emitted restart_exhausted before reconstruction. The model job failed and no semantic phase verdict was produced.
